name: AERO Task Hub
description: Role-aware task and effort tracking for the SAE AERO Design team.

RAILS_MASTER_KEY.description: Rails production credentials key. Configure this securely; never commit it.

DEMO_PASSWORD.description: Practice account password shared separately with authorized testers.

GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.description: Google sign-in client ID from the organization's Google Cloud project (see docs/ADMIN_GUIDE.md).

GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Google sign-in client secret from the same project. Configure securely; never commit it.

PASSWORD_SIGN_IN.description: Set to off once everyone signs in with Google.
